about: Revival Blessing picked by the trainer AI in a double battle and the revived Pokemon sent out on the AI's side (ov12_0225F8AC and RevivalBlessingStep). The Twins' double battle in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with a level-30 Pawmot and a level-30 Baxcalibur on the twins' platform, both given Snarl, which hits both foes, in the running battle (teach:). The twins' Ledyba is given Wonder Guard (set:), which Snarl cannot pass, and only Splash; the Spinarak, then the Karrablast and the Shelmet sent in its place, each left only Splash too (teach:: with its own moves the Karrablast came to use Endure at 1 HP once another build changed the run's timing, the AI's pick being a roll, and stood), are set to 1 HP and fall, leaving that place empty with no one to send. Then the Ledyba knows only Revival Blessing: the AI revives the Spinarak, the first fainted in its party, at half its HP, rounded down (23 of 47), and sends it out into the empty place. That it comes in at the turn's end, the Spinarak having fallen turns before, is the open question of the audit's row on a Revival Blessing into a place already empty.
